role: The thrown ender pearl: on impact it teleports the throwing player to where it landed and deals 5 fall damage.

members.name: EntityEnderPearl
members.note: EntityList's NBT constructor: a pearl still in flight when its chunk unloads; the replay keeps loaded chunks for the flight, and no survival path builds a pearl this way

members.name: EntityEnderPearl
members.note: throw.c:spawn_throwable wraps it from ItemEnderPearl.onItemRightClick's use; proj_throwable_heading ports the ctor heading and 1.5F velocity

members.name: EntityEnderPearl
members.note: no vanilla caller in survival: dispensers do not fire pearls (BlockDispenser's registry) and redstone is off

members.name: onImpact
members.note: the entityHit.attackEntityFrom(causeThrownDamage, 0.0F) is in projectile_update's hit branch, the 32 portal particles' rand draws and setDead in pearl_on_impact, and the teleport half in throw.c:pearl_impact: only when the thrower's world is the pearl's (pearl-dims-s1), setPositionAndUpdate (fallDistance 0, attackEntityFrom(fall, 5.0F)); a pearl whose thrower died and respawned keeps the old EntityPlayerMP, so its setPositionAndUpdate moves the successor through the shared net handler (rotation 0, 0) and the 5 damage hits the dead object (pearl-death-s1); the riding thrower steps off first (riding.c ride_server_dismount).

notes: ItemEnderPearl.onItemRightClick itself lives in csrc/engine/throw.c (IT_ENDER_PEARL in throw_server_use and throw_client_use) and is that file's record, not this one. EntityThrowable's shared fields (xTile, ownerName and so on) are written by csrc/engine/living.c:item_entity_write_nbt for IE_ENDER_PEARL. throw-items-s1 covers a pearl thrown onto a stone hill with the teleport and 5 damage; test_projectiles.c drives the IE_ENDER_PEARL kind through projectile_update. Not verified: the thrown-damage DamageSource plumbing against DMG_THROWN for a hit on a non-living ie_ent. lane/idxentity: only the thrower constructor is reached in play, and it is exact.
